svg.text: CypherMonkey · Webex Lab · not a vendor document
On-net app to app — Register to Calling. If ICE succeeds, media can go direct.
Outbound PSTN — Location routing choice, then Cisco Calling Plan, CCP, or the Local Gateway.
Contact center — Entry point, flow, queue, agent. Not a CUCM route pattern.
Emergency — Phone or app to RedSky on 443, then the emergency network. Test with 933.
